Description: Add Halaman extraction for limbah and ngo datasets to show them in the expander
Instruction: Extract 'Halaman' from the 'Catatan' column so it can be displayed as requested by the user.
ReplacementContent:
# Data untuk Map 2 (Limbah B3)
df_limbah = pd.read_csv('data/processed/sulawesi_limbah_b3.csv')
df_limbah['Estimasi_Clean'] = df_limbah['Estimasi Timbulan (Ton/Tahun)'].astype(str).str.replace(r'[^0-9]', '', regex=True)
df_limbah['Estimasi_Clean'] = pd.to_numeric(df_limbah['Estimasi_Clean'], errors='coerce').fillna(0)
df_limbah_prov = df_limbah.groupby('Provinsi')['Estimasi_Clean'].sum().reset_index()

if 'Halaman' not in df_limbah.columns:
    df_limbah['Halaman'] = df_limbah['Catatan'].str.extract(r'\(Hlm\.\s*([^)]+)\)')
df_limbah['Halaman'] = df_limbah['Halaman'].fillna('-')

# Data untuk Map 3 (Pencemaran / Cr6+ NGO Proxy)
df_ngo = pd.read_csv('data/processed/sulawesi_limbah_b3_ngo_proxy.csv')
df_ngo['Estimasi_Clean'] = df_ngo['Estimasi Timbulan (Ton/Tahun)'].astype(str).str.replace(r'[^0-9]', '', regex=True)
df_ngo['Estimasi_Clean'] = pd.to_numeric(df_ngo['Estimasi_Clean'], errors='coerce').fillna(0)
df_ngo_prov = df_ngo.groupby('Provinsi')['Estimasi_Clean'].sum().reset_index()

if 'Halaman' not in df_ngo.columns:
    df_ngo['Halaman'] = df_ngo['Catatan'].str.extract(r'\(Hlm\.\s*([^)]+)\)')
df_ngo['Halaman'] = df_ngo['Halaman'].fillna('-')
